pelage_geometry_and_topology.patch_morphology: Large, irregularly polygonal patches with moderately smooth edge gradients, though affected by slight motion blur. Patch area is maximal at the shoulder and decreases toward the posterior flank.
pelage_geometry_and_topology.corridor_network: Continuous network of light-colored negative space with thick, well-defined pathways. Junction nodes primarily consist of three-way intersections forming a stable topological lattice across the visible torso.

dorsal_ridge_profile.edge_serration: A continuous mane along the upper neck and shoulder hump exhibiting a low-amplitude, high-frequency serrated silhouette against the out-of-focus background.

focal_dorsal_anomalies.chronic_feeding_lesions: Localized clusters of darker, hyper-pigmented pixels within the patches along the dorsal ridge and uppermost shoulder area, distinct from the standard brown tone of the lateral pelage.

other_distinctive_markers: Presence of two avian silhouettes (oxpeckers) clinging to the coat: one positioned on the lower anterior shoulder and another near the posterior rump.
